thread:
Nora (People Ops): Post-all-hands thread for travel/offsite/workspace Qs. I'll collect answers and pin a short How-To.
Miles (CEO): Thanks Nora. Two asks: clearer approval paths and a one-pager for managers.
Aria (Design): For a 6-person sketching retreat overseas, do we need a PO or can the design card handle it?
Nora (People Ops): If total spend <= $3k and you use team card, card is fine. For >$3k or vendor contracts, submit a PO via procurement and loop Finance (Clara).
Ben (Eng): Can we ship loaner GPUs to an offsite location?
Nora (People Ops): Yes if approved by Eng Ops. Submit Equipment Travel Request with serials and travel dates. Eng Security signs off for hardware leaving region.
Clara (Finance): Expense caps: hotel $225/night (standard US hubs), meals $65/day. Exceptions need manager + finance OK. Attach itemized receipts or we can't reimburse.
Aria (Design): Are shared Airbnbs allowed for small teams? We want common space for workshops.
Clara (Finance): Allowed when itemized invoice lists host and nights. Prefer hotels for tax/invoice clarity but Airbnbs OK with documentation.
Ben (Eng): What about same-day desk drop-ins? I sometimes get into hub last minute.
DeskBot: Desk reservation update: same-day drop-ins permitted subject to capacity. Reservation window opens 10 days in advance for this hub.
Nora (People Ops): Vendor visitors: sponsor required, notify office@redwood 5 business days ahead. >10 business days -> security review.
Miles (CEO): Leadership note: prefer more frequent small team syncs over single big annual retreat. Managers, please prioritize local meetups.
Nora (People Ops): I'll post the one-pager (approvals, forms, expense samples) here by Thurs: https://intra.redwood/workstyle/quick-guide. If edge cases, drop them below and we'll add to FAQ. :sparkles:
